Frequently Asked Questions

What is IR35?

IR35 is a piece of UK tax legislation that affects contractors who work through their own limited company. It determines whether you should be taxed as an employee or as a self-employed individual.

How is my IR35 status determined?

Your IR35 status is determined by your working practices and contract terms. Key factors include control, substitution, and mutuality of obligation. If your contract resembles that of an employee, you may be deemed inside IR35.
